{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Equitrans Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Wetzel County, West Virginia to Greene County, Pennsylvania.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/05/18/2011-12118.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Equitrans LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/05/18/2011-12118.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''313.56 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''44.4 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/05/18/2011-12118.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''16, 24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/05/18/2011-12118.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2012<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$272,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
